data.exact_reserve_text: Underwriting performance has been further supplemented by favourable development from prior accident years. Due to a light incurred claims development on short tail lines the Syndicate has released reserves of GBP 2.3m (2013: GBP 4.5m) from Property. The Syndicate also experienced light incurred claims development and a release of claims provision in prior years in relation to Professional Lines and Accident & Health business, resulting in favourable prior year development of GBP 3.4m (2013: GBP 5.0m) and GBP 2.3m (2013: loss 0.4m) respectively.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports a net favourable prior-year reserve movement driven by light claims development across short-tail lines and the absence of catastrophe losses. Management disclosed releases in Property, Professional Lines and Accident & Health totalling approximately GBP 8.0m, representing around a 3.7% release versus opening gross claims outstanding.
raw_causal_phrases: favourable development from prior accident years
light incurred claims development on short tail lines
released reserves of GBP 2.3m (2013: GBP 4.5m) from Property
resulting in favourable prior year development of GBP 3.4m (2013: GBP 5.0m) and GBP 2.3m (2013: loss 0.4m) respectively
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure derived by summing narrative line-item releases disclosed in the Strategic Report (Property GBP 2.3m, Professional Lines GBP 3.4m, Accident & Health GBP 2.3m). The formal note showing a gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' was not available in the provided pages. The narrative figures may be net of reinsurance; gross movement could not be confirmed from the available pages.
